title: Information processing is an experiential process

statements.text: Prehension plays the role that information processing plays for computationalists, but as a process of feeling, so the detection of form is embodied in experience. At any scale, information processing is experiential, with an intensity set by how far the prehended data are integrated by a society of occasions.

sources.quote: Prehension is akin to the ‘information processing’ of computationalists
information processing is an experiential process, with the intensity of experience depending on the degree of integration of prehended data achieved by any given society of occasions
